sloka: ससञ्ज्ञस्तु मुहूर्तेन स विश्रम्य निशाचरः ।तं यक्षं योधयामास स च भग्नः प्रदुद्रुवे ।। ७.१४.२३ ॥
transliteration: sasañjñastu muhūrtena sa viśramya niśācaraḥ ।taṁ yakṣaṁ yodhayāmāsa sa ca bhagnaḥ pradudruve ।। 7.14.23 ॥

translations.english: However, the night-wanderer Maricha regained consciousness in a moment, rested, and then fought that Yaksha, who was subsequently defeated and fled.
